verdict.rationale: Ramp documents automatically enforced card-level limits: virtual cards carry per-vendor spending limits (ramp-docs-31), and agent cards are merchant- and amount-scoped. It also has 'spend programs' that act as recurring-budget templates, and its live MCP server exposes limits, spend_programs and departments read/write scopes, which points to a programmatic limit and program surface. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of department-level budgets, a description of how program budgets enforce limits beyond agent purchases, and independent or hands-on corroboration of budget enforcement.
